title: Female Rights & The Hindu Code Bill
description: Dr. Ambedkar framed legislation to secure women's absolute ownership over property inheritance, equality in marriage, divorce rights, and the abolition of polygamy. He resigned as Law Minister when Parliament stalled its passage.

title: Article 32: Heart and Soul of the Constitution
description: Guarantees direct access to the Supreme Court for writ remedies (Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Quo Warranto, and Certiorari), ensuring fundamental citizen rights are enforceable against government excess.

title: 8-Hour Workday & Social Security Frameworks
description: Ambedkar reduced the standard working day from 12 hours to 8 hours and created the statutory foundation for maternity benefits, the tripartite labor conference, and the Employees' State Insurance Act.

title: Universal Adult Franchise (One Man, One Vote, One Value)
description: Advocated for unconditional voting rights for every adult citizen regardless of literacy, property ownership, or gender, breaking the colonial property-qualification barrier.
